web/AutoTranslationDefaults.tsx.reason: LANGUAGE_NAMES names each written language in itself, so Korean reads 한국어 in every UI language.

web/LanguageSelect.tsx.reason: The UI language picker names each language in itself, so a reader can find their own language from any other.

web/native-toggle-document.ts.reason: The default label and select options of a new toggle are written into the stored toggle source; docs/I18N.md keeps new items' default names in the stored data format.

web/pricing-display.ts.reason: Frozen cost estimates in stored attempts carry this Korean note from before notes became codes; pricingNote compares against it to render the catalog message.

web/public/sw.js.reason: The service worker cannot import web/locales; notificationCatalogs is its own four-language table, and these are its Korean entries.

web/reading-sample.ts.reason: The reading preview's prose sample and its credit are a fixed public-domain Korean passage; docs/I18N.md keeps theme and reading preview fixtures as written.

web/resource-editor-session.ts.reason: The title an untitled default prompt carries in the helper capture is a model input, which docs/I18N.md keeps out of the UI language.

web/story-ui-preview.ts.reason: The story UI theme preview is a fixed Korean story fixture; docs/I18N.md keeps theme and reading preview fixtures as written.

web/useStory.ts.reason: A pasted image without a file name is stored and sent with the request under this name, a model input that docs/I18N.md keeps out of the UI language.
